The backend and client source enforce the permitted ASCII password character set before a registration request can complete.
The backend compares confirmPassword with password and the frontend prevents submission when they differ.
Registration source persists only fullName, email and passwordHash; the entity/migration have no confirmPassword column, and inspected registration source contains no input logging.
Backend validation precedes persistence and throws standard errors; frontend validation returns before the API call and creates no session on its error path. Runtime rejection remains unobserved.
Source hashes the password with bcrypt cost 10 before save; persistence uses passwordHash rather than plaintext, and the success payload includes only token and public user fields.
